name: omp-fusion
description: Fusion — run a hard question through an independent parallel model panel, then a judge synthesizes. An OMP skill + slash commands (installs on vanilla pi too; parallel fan-out is OMP-native). Also ships /ultrafusion: N proposers -> M critics -> aggregator planning pipeline, plus omp-fusion/fusion-fast and fusion-samp fast-path variants.
author: Jordan Strauss

omp.name: fusion
omp.description: Independent parallel model panel -> judge synthesis, plus an /ultrafusion planning pipeline (N proposers -> M critics -> aggregator). Ships the fusion skill + /fusion[-solo|-pair|-trio] commands and the ultrafusion skill + /ultrafusion command. Uses the bundled `task` agent in plugin mode, so no custom-agent install is required. Configure via modelRoles (fusion_panel_*/fusion_judge and ultrafusion_proposer_*/ultrafusion_critic_*/ultrafusion_aggregator). Also registers an `omp-fusion` provider with four models: omp-fusion/fusion (panel->judge), fusion-fast (majority-quorum proposers->aggregator), fusion-samp (random-sampled proposers->aggregator), and ultrafusion (proposers->critics->aggregator).
